verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents its own pre-request scripts: code snippets that run before a request is sent. Its docs also mention scripting for pre-request logic and test cases. Post-response scripting is implied only through test cases, and nothing shows scripts setting variables to chain requests or transform response data. missing for 10: explicit post-response scripting docs, documented request chaining (e.g. setting environment variables from responses), data-transformation examples, scripting API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script pre-request and post-response logic to chain requests and massage data

citations.quote: Snippets of code associated with a request that is executed before the request is sent.
